values: Scope: Step / Qwen / Grok / ElevenLabs. Required coverage: long text + frequent interrupt stress for every provider.
Interrupt after audio starts must not leak old speech fragments.
Normal close / done must not clip final syllable or tail audio.
Frequent interrupts must not leave worker stuck, silent, or requiring restart.
New speech after interrupt must not be contaminated by old buffer audio.
请用自然语速朗读下面这段长文本：现在开始进行实时语音压力测试。请连续说出一段较长的说明，包含多个短句、停顿、数字一二三四五六七八九十，以及一个明显的收尾句：测试文本即将结束，请保持声音稳定直到最后一个字。
INT-01: first audible audio. INT-02: middle of response. INT-03: near ending. STRESS-01: repeat rapidly without waiting for full playback.
好了。 / 测试结束。 / 收到。 / 可以了。 / 完成。
